test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

Ammu said, "How brilliant I am!"

options.text: Ammu exclaimed that she has been brilliant.
Ammu exclaimed that she is brilliant.
Ammu exclaimed that she was being brilliant.
Ammu exclaimed that she was brilliant.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Ammu exclaimed that she was brilliant.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"How brilliant I am!" becomes "that she was brilliant"**
 
 
• Exclamatory sentence "How brilliant I am!" is converted to a statement "that she was brilliant."
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "she" to match the reported speech.
 
• Verb "am" is changed to "was" to match the past tense in reported speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with an exclamatory phrase "How" and ends with an exclamation mark "!".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Ammu exclaimed that she was brilliant."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Ammu exclaimed that she has been brilliant." 
 
 
• Tense is incorrect; it should be in the past tense "was" instead of "has been."
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Ammu exclaimed that she is brilliant." 
 
 
• Tense is incorrect; it should be in the past tense "was" instead of "is."
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Ammu exclaimed that she was being brilliant." 
 
 
• The verb form "was being" is awkward and incorrect in this context.
